Isolated mitochondria were used to investigate respiration.

• Mitochondria were extracted from respiring mammalian cells and incubated in a buffer solution.
• Pyruvate and inorganic phosphate (Pi) were added at time zero.
• ADP was added one minute later.
• The oxygen concentration of the buffer solution containing mitochondria was monitored throughout the investigation.

The results of the investigation are shown in Fig. 7.1.
